summary: Comprehensive frontend-only Playwright UI testing of the redesigned MedLingo Vite single-page site at http://localhost:3000. All 14 requested functional items verified end-to-end on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844) viewports. Zero console errors, zero pageerrors throughout.

test_results.default_light_theme: PASS - data-theme='light' on <html> on first load
test_results.navbar_scroll_blur: PASS - navbar gets 'scrolled' class after scrolling past 30px
test_results.navlinks_visible: PASS - navlink-features, navlink-modules, navlink-team all visible & clickable
test_results.smooth_scroll: PASS - clicking navlink-modules smooth-scrolls modules section into view
test_results.theme_toggle_desktop: PASS - clicking [data-testid='theme-toggle'] flips light<->dark, localStorage key 'medlingo-theme' updated correctly
test_results.theme_persistence: PASS - after setting localStorage to 'dark' and reloading, data-theme='dark' persists
test_results.hero_section: PASS - hero, hero-cta-waitlist, hero-cta-modules, hero-flashcard all visible
test_results.hero_ctas_scroll: PASS - hero-cta-modules scrolls to #modules; hero-cta-waitlist scrolls to #waitlist
test_results.flashcard_flip: PASS - aria-pressed toggles from 'false' to 'true' on click
test_results.activities_section: PASS - data-testid='activities' visible, activities-key-badge present on Speaking card
test_results.modules_tabs: PASS - phase1 & phase2 tabs work; clicking phase2 shows lock overlay elements (29 lock-class nodes detected)
test_results.waitlist_form: PASS - email input accepts input, submit triggers POST to formspree, success state [data-testid='waitlist-success'] shown after submission (Formspree call mocked to ensure deterministic UI test)
test_results.waitlist_counter: PASS - animated counter counts up to exactly '124' when scrolled into view (observed mid-animation at 89, final at 124)
test_results.footer: PASS - data-testid='footer' visible with Privacy Policy & Contact links and © 2026 copyright
test_results.back_to_top: PASS - appears after scrolling past 500px (hidden at top); clicking scrolls window to scrollY=0
test_results.mobile_menu: PASS - hamburger [data-testid='navbar-menu-button'] toggles [data-testid='mobile-menu'] open; theme-toggle-mobile present and flips theme (light->dark verified)
test_results.accessibility_aria: PASS - theme-toggle has aria-label 'Switch to light/dark mode'; navbar-menu-button has 'Toggle navigation menu'; CTAs have proper labels
test_results.console_errors: PASS - 0 console errors and 0 pageerrors across all test runs (desktop + mobile)

critical_code_review_comments: Counter animation is tied to scroll-into-view; works as designed. Verified animates from low value up to exactly 124.

Footer logo image appears slightly stretched/low-fidelity in screenshots — likely the brand asset rendered at low res; not a functional bug, but main agent may want to verify the source asset resolution.

Formspree submission is a real third-party POST. UI flow handles success state properly; failure case (network error) would render inline error per the form handler — not stress-tested with a failing mock in this iteration.
All testable interactive elements have data-testid attributes — excellent testability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Vite dev server runs at http://localhost:3000 in /app (NOT /app/frontend). No backend exists. Formspree is the only external dep — mock https://formspree.io/** routes in Playwright for deterministic waitlist success tests. Theme key in localStorage is 'medlingo-theme'. All 14 requested behaviours passed without issues. Mobile breakpoint = 390px width; hamburger appears only at ≤860px.
rca of the issue: No issues found — nothing to RCA.
